en: Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process
zh: 修复了更新或版本清理删除了仍在运行的进程的二进制文件后，`claude remote-control` 主机、后台守护进程和自托管运行器无法启动新 session（`spawn ENOENT`）的问题
